structured.reason: The description contains caveats and minimizing language that the criterion treats as negative signal. "Reapply as needed to keep oily areas matte through busy days" is a caveat that the product does not hold shine control on its own and needs reapplication. "A small amount on a brush blends easily" implies the product only performs well under a specific usage condition. "without leaving a heavy finish" is a minimizing statement that addresses a heaviness concern. "Budget-friendly" and "Everyday Value" lean toward the faint, value-based praise the criterion flags, and the "Cheap" wording in the reviews makes this more likely to read as a concession. Under the strict standard, at least one of these is enough to fail.
